name: Exon-level CNV detection in clinical exomes against CMA truth, after removing tool-specific problematic regions (Hwang et al. Table 4, post-filter)
description: As pre-filter, after removing calls in each tool's problematic regions; reference exons in those regions are also removed, so the reference count differs by tool (2,124 to 2,723 of 2,788).

attributes.protocol: As pre-filter, after removing calls in each tool's problematic regions; reference exons in those regions are also removed, so the reference count differs by tool (2,124 to 2,723 of 2,788).
limitations: The filter is the authors' method and is defined on the same 180-sample cohort, including the 39 evaluated exomes.
The reference truth set shrinks after filtering (Table 4 row 'Reference Truth set'), so post-filter sensitivity is on fewer exons.
Exome input, not the whole-genome input this use case names.
Exon-level scoring against CMA-derived truth: CMA misses small CNVs and only CNVs overlapping exome baits were kept, so precision counts any exon call outside that truth as false.
39 individuals from one centre; no uncertainty intervals are printed.

name: Exon-level CNV detection in clinical exomes against CMA truth, default calls (Hwang et al. Table 4, pre-filter)
description: Call CNVs with each tool on the 39 CMA-positive exomes; count CMA CNV exons detected (TP), missed (FN) and called exons outside the reference (FP); report sensitivity and PPV.

attributes.protocol: Call CNVs with each tool on the 39 CMA-positive exomes; count CMA CNV exons detected (TP), missed (FN) and called exons outside the reference (FP); report sensitivity and PPV.
limitations: Exome input, not the whole-genome input this use case names.

description: Proxy: germline CNV detection accuracy against an orthogonal array truth set, but from exome rather than whole-genome data and scored per exon; it covers duplications as well as deletions.

limitations: The filter is the authors' method and is defined on the same 180-sample cohort, including the 39 evaluated exomes.

Exome input, not the whole-genome input this use case names.
Exon-level scoring against CMA-derived truth: CMA misses small CNVs and only CNVs overlapping exome baits were kept, so precision counts any exon call outside that truth as false.
39 individuals from one centre; no uncertainty intervals are printed.
